svg.title: Lesson feature component architecture
svg.desc: App modules call new API routes; the lesson repository admits jobs transactionally; the GPU runner dispatches buildLesson claims to the lesson worker, which uses the lesson_pipeline library and a credential-free adapter that talks to the motion bridge.
